name: JoAi: Update Artifact

description.en: Edit an existing delivery artifact — title, summary, URLs, status, contact, or order attachment.
description.de: Ein bestehendes Lieferartefakt bearbeiten — Titel, Summary, URLs, Status, Kontakt oder Order.

bot: Use this to change artifact fields or mark status ready/archived. To send to the client, use artifact-deliver instead.

inputs.name: Artifact ID
inputs.bot: Opaque public hashid from the list or get API. Never use a numeric internal database id — only the public hashid (or slug where documented).

description.en: Public hashid (not an internal database id)

inputs.name: Blocks

description.en: Replacement JSON array of ordered document blocks: id, type, data.
description.de: Ersetzendes JSON-Array geordneter Dokumentblöcke: id, type, data.

inputs.bot: When supplied, this replaces the full structured document. Supported types: heading, richText, metrics, table, callout, actions, media, divider.

inputs.name: Media

description.en: Replacement team media IDs, e.g. ["abc123"]. Pass [] to clear. Upload with media_upload first.
description.de: Ersetzende Team-Medien-IDs, z.B. ["abc123"]. [] zum Leeren. Zuerst mit media_upload hochladen.

inputs.bot: Optional. Replaces attached files. Upload with media_upload, then pass media IDs as a JSON array. Pass [] to clear attachments.

inputs.name: Contact
inputs.bot: Opaque public hashid from the list or get API. Never use a numeric internal database id — only the public hashid (or slug where documented).

description.en: Public hashid (not an internal database id)

inputs.name: Order ID
inputs.bot: Opaque public hashid from the list or get API. Never use a numeric internal database id — only the public hashid (or slug where documented).

description.en: Public hashid (not an internal database id)

inputs.name: Team

description.en: Team slug for this action. Defaults to the current team.
description.de: Team-Slug für diese Aktion. Standardmäßig das aktuelle Team.

inputs.bot: The slug of the team to operate on. Omit to use the current team.
